pages.text: A placed head is a $(l)trophy$() until someone pays it by hand: use its wage on it, wheat for a cow, two rotten flesh for a zombie. That hires it, and the payer is its employer.
Staff wear a badge in the employer's team colour, company teal without one.$(br2)At each dawn a head on the payroll takes one wage from a chest, barrel or other container touching it.
A head left unloaded for a week takes one wage, not seven. A trophy never touches the chest beside it.$(br2)Paying by hand twice in a day does nothing: it was paid today.

Starts at 50: +10 a wage paid, -15 a dawn unpaid.$(br)$(l)Engaged$(), 75-100: chin up$(br)$(l)Content$(), 40-74$(br)$(l)Disengaged$(), 15-39: sags, looks away$(br)$(l)Grievance$(): under 15 two dawns running. A label, for now.
pages.title: Form 40-M: Morale

pages.text: Heads at stations show Content.$(br)An Employee Mount's villager, by its pay: today and yesterday, Engaged; today, Content; unpaid 1-2 days, Disengaged; 3 or more, Grievance.
pages.title: Form 40-M (2)

pages.text: A villager head is never paid by hand: an emerald in hand opens its trades, as it always has.$(br2)Slimes, ghasts, tadpoles and a few others draw no wage, so they stay trophies.$(br2)$(o)A pizza party is not a pay rise.$()
